description: Province of Pistoia, Biciplan publishes complementary layers for the provincial cycling-mobility plan: existing itineraries, cycle stations, drinking fountains along cycling routes and accidents on those routes. The layers share the Biciplan publisher, 9 July 2025 metadata date, declared coordinate-system code 3003 and geographic coverage in Pistoia province. ISO metadata lists Shapefile, KML, GML and GeoJSON formats together with WMS and WFS access. Public access is free under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. These layers can support cycling-network flow and route-planning inputs. Their common planning context supports grouping them as one resource; it does not prove feature-level joins or temporal alignment. Accident observation dates, asset counts, coordinate accuracy and completeness remain unspecified. No data features or archive contents were fetched. The related, already catalogued widespread-cycling areas are a separate Biciplan layer and are not added again.
